content: Biniyaame biittan Anatoote kataman diza qeesetappe issaa Kilqiyaasa naa Ermaasi yootida qaalay hayssafe kaallizayssa.
Amoone naa Yuhuda kawo Iyosiyaasi kawotida tammanne heedzdzanththo layththan GODAA qaalay Ermaasakko yides.

Qasse Iyosiyaasa naa Yuhuda Kawo Iyo7aaqemey kawotida layththatan GODAA qaalay Ermaasakko yides. Hessafe guye Iyosiyaasa naa Sedeqiyaasi kawotiin tammanne issinththa layththan he wode ichchashanththa aginan Yerusalaame asay di7ettidi baana gakkanaas GODAA qaalay Ermaasa baggara izas yootettides.
Histtiin tani, «Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU! Tani buro naa gidida gishshas ay ga haasayanaakko ta erikke» gadis.
Gido attiin GODAY tana, « ‹Tani naa› gooppa. Tani nena kiittiza asa ubbaakko ba. Tani azaziyssa ubbaaka yoota.
Tani nena ashshanaas nenara diza gishshas ne isttas yayyofa; tani GODAY hayssa nees yootays» gides.
GODAY ba kushe yeddidi ta metershata bochchidi, «Hekko ne yootana ta qaala ne doonan woththadis.
Neni shoddanaassinne laallanaas, dhayssanaassinne shira yegganaas, keexxanaassinne tokkanaas dereta bollanne kawoteththata bolla tani hach nena shuumadis» gides.
GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi, «Ermaasaa! Ne ay be7ay?» gi oychchides. Tanikka, «Ochcholoone hagga be7ays» gadis.
GODAY tana, «Neni likke be7adasa. Tanikka ta qaalay polettanayssa tishshi histta be7ays» gides.
GODAA qaalay qasseka taakko yiidi, «Haray aazi nees beettizee?» gi oychchides. Tanikka zaarada, «Issi penttiza otoy pudeha baggafe haa geddi gi uttidayssi beettees» gadis.
GODAY taas, «Pudeha baggafe bashshi dhuuqqidi ha biittan diza asaa ubbaa bolla gukkana.

Tani pudeha baggan diza kawoteththata haa yaana mala xeygana; Yerusalaameninne izi yuushon diza Yuhuda katamata bolla meto gaththidi istta oykkana; hessafe guye Yerusalaame geliza pengeta bolla bantta araata miccana.
«Neni gidikko giigetta! Denda eqqada tani nena azazizayssa ubbaa isttas yoota; isttas yayyofa. Neni isttas yayyiko tani nena istta sinththan gujja yashissana.

«Hach tani nena ha biitta ubbaa bolla, Yuhuda kawota bolla, halaqata bolla, qeeseta bollanne ha biitta asaa bolla ne eqetta dandayana mala gimbettida katama, birata tuussinne xarqimalappe oosettida birata dirsa mala ooththadis.
Istti nenara olettana; gido attiin tani ashshanaas nenara issife diza gishshas nena xoonettenna. Tani GODAY hayssa nees yootays» gides.
